name: AR_CUST_CREDIT_AUTHORIZATION
description: This entity describes credit amounts that have been authorized for a customer account.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the customer account. Foreign key to the HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS table.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifying number for the credit authorization. It is generated when the credit authorization amount is approved.

columns.name: REQUEST_AUTH_AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount requested for credit checking, and is approved.  It should be the same amount as that from the requested sales order line with the corresponding authorization number.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code associated with an authorization amount.

columns.name: CREDIT_AUTH_AMOUNT
columns.description: Authorized amount converted to the credit limit currency using the conversion rate defined on the customer account profile.

columns.name: REM_AUTH_AMOUNT
columns.description: Remaining authorized amount converted to the credit limit currency using the conversion rate defined on the customer account profile.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Currency conversion rate type associated with the authorization currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Currency conversion rate associated with the authorization currency

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_DATE
columns.description: Date and time the credit amount was authorized.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the status of the authorization, based on the system lookup values.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: Expiration date and time of the authorized amount.

columns.name: EXCLUDE_FROM_EXPIRATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the authorization is finalized.

columns.name: RECURRENCE_PERIOD
columns.description: Used for price types other than one-time to indicate the recurring time period.

columns.name: PRICE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the basis on which a price applies. Valid values are: One-Time, Recurring, Usage, Recurring Usage and Rate Plan.

columns.name: CREDIT_AUTHORIZATION_ID
columns.description: Credit authorization unique identifier.

columns.name: CREDIT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Credit currency defined in the customer or customer account profile.

columns.name: AUTH_UPDATE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Indicates the request identifier of the most recent process which updates the authorization detail table.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER
columns.description: Indicates the Sales Order Number for which the authorization is requested.
